title: crepidiastrum surugense
intro: Crepidiastrum surugense, commonly known as Japanese comfrey, is a perennial plant species native to East Asia. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. Its health benefits include wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as tissue repair, pain relief, and immune system modulation. The bioactive constituents of Crepidiastrum surugense include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
